comment: Routing-table commands of the laneconductor skill that have NO command file in plugins/laneconductor/commands/. connector/test/plugin-coverage.test.mjs fails when a routing-table name is neither a command (or an alias of one, below) nor listed here.

init-tracks-summary.reason: The connector regenerates tracks-summary.md on every write; `lc summary` remains for plain edits made outside the connector.

revert.reason: Needs judgement about which commit and which phase to undo; a thin command would hide that decision.

delete.reason: Destructive, no undo, and the skill runs it only when named; a one-keystroke command invites accidents. The safe alternative is /laneconductor:move N backlog.
